key_highlights: ASX closed a volatile week in the red, pressured by lower oil prices and rising bond yields; sentiment remains fragile
RBA issued a blunt warning ahead of its next rate decision, reinforcing 'higher for longer' narrative
Iron ore prices under pressure, weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; LNG export dynamics shifting with Japan absorbing more Australian gas
Recession odds for 2027 rising; global 'four horsemen' risk narrative gaining traction
Super contributions surged >33% post-budget tax changes, supporting financials and fund managers
Housing affordability at record lows; stamp duty and auction market cooling signal structural stress
Gold exploration momentum continues with Forrestania and Aurum prefeasibility wins
Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman, marking a generational shift in global capital allocation

sectors.trend: Iron ore weakness and LNG export reallocation to Japan pressure major miners; gold exploration names (Forrestania, Aurum) show relative strength
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin headwinds; gold juniors (AUR.AX, FGN.AX) offer counter-cyclical exposure

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance supports NIMs but caps credit growth; super contribution surge benefits fund managers and banks
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from rate environment but face rising NPL risk if recession materialises; super funds see AUM tailwind

sectors.trend: Lower oil prices and petrol price shock hurt upstream; Victoria and Qld pull back on renewable transmission, creating policy uncertainty
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX face commodity headwinds; renewable developers (SOL.AX, IGR.AX) face policy risk; EV adoption accelerates demand shift

sectors.trend: Consumer confidence deteriorating; housing unaffordability and stamp duty costs suppress transaction volumes; discount retail under pressure
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin pressure; REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) see occupancy risk; property sector structurally challenged

sectors.trend: Mental health service gaps highlight demand; ASX small-caps (Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan) show momentum; cybersecurity concerns in EV sector
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX benefit from demographic tailwinds (longer lives, fewer children); tech small-caps offer speculative upside

key_themes: Commodity price softness across iron ore and oil
Renewable energy policy fragmentation across states

risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain duration hedges; favour rate-sensitive financials with strong capital buffers; monitor ^AORD for yield signals
Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and defensive materials
Underweight property REITs; monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX credit cost provisions
Avoid state-dependent renewable developers; favour integrated energy majors with diversified portfolios
Maintain 15-20% cash allocation; favour domestic revenue streams (WES.AX, CSL.AX)

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration and production names
opportunities.rationale: Forrestania and Aurum prefeasibility wins signal sector momentum; gold benefits from rate uncertainty and recession hedging

opportunities.recommendation: Add to defensive healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Demographic tailwinds (longer lives, mental health demand) and recession resilience support CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX
Latrobe, CurveBeam, Arrow, Sultan showing relative strength in weak tape; speculative but high-beta opportunity

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and oil exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore weakness and falling oil prices create sustained margin pressure; LNG export dynamics shifting unfavourably
Housing unaffordability, stamp duty burden, and auction market cooling signal structural demand destruction

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration bonds or inverse ETFs
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA hawkish bias and 'higher for longer' narrative create tail risk for equity valuations

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain range-bound to slightly lower over 1-3 months. RBA decision is the key catalyst; hawkish hold or hike would pressure ^AXJO further. Oil and iron ore weakness caps materials. Super contribution surge provides a partial offset for financials. Expect volatility around RBA meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious. Rising 2027 recession odds, housing affordability crisis, and global demand risks argue for a 5-10% drawdown scenario. However, gold, healthcare, and domestic consumer staples offer relative outperformance. Structural super reform debate may create policy catalysts. Buffett's exit signals a shift in global capital flows that may reduce US equity appetite, indirectly pressuring ASX via AUD.
key_catalysts: Iron ore and oil price trajectory
watch_list: RBA cash rate and statement tone
Iron ore spot price (62% Fe) vs $90/tonne support
Housing credit approvals and auction clearance rates
LNG contract pricing (Japan vs East Coast)
